setup.choose-goal.title: Choose your connection
setup.codex-ready.title: Sign in to Codex
setup.codex-ready.explain: Install Codex Desktop and sign in. On Linux, install and sign in to Codex CLI in your terminal.
setup.claude-code-ready.title: Prepare Claude Code
setup.claude-code-ready.explain: Cloud session notifications require Claude Code. Your Agent installs the official client and then guides you to sign in. You can skip, but completion notifications will be unavailable.
setup.claude-code-ready.done: Claude Code CLI authenticated, or skip chosen
setup.permissions.title: Grant local permissions
setup.permissions.explain: Grant Full Disk Access in ARC Settings → Permissions & readiness, including Codex command access where applicable. Accessibility and screen recording optionally enable screen tools; notifications enable notification fallback—choose whether to enable these now.
setup.permissions.done: Full Disk Access granted (or not applicable), including command access where applicable, or skip chosen
setup.choose-address.title: Choose a connection address
setup.choose-address.explain: A public address lets your remote conversation reach this computer. A temporary address needs no configuration but changes after ARC restarts; a fixed address remains usable and needs a provider account.
setup.address-secret.title: Enter fixed-address credentials
setup.address-secret.explain: Your Agent configures the provider and fixed address, then uses the official copy button to transfer the credential to ARC. ARC saves it and clears the clipboard. If no copy button exists, copy manually or use the ARC form; never send credentials in chat.
setup.address-secret.done: Provider credential saved for this connection
setup.create-ingress.title: Start and check the connection
setup.create-ingress.explain: ARC starts the connection and checks public connectivity or OpenAI control-plane authentication. A running process alone does not mean the connection is ready.
setup.create-ingress.done: Connection running with public connectivity or OpenAI authentication confirmed
setup.add-connector.title: Add the remote connection
setup.add-connector.explain: Your Agent adds this connection address to Claude or ChatGPT with OAuth and completes connection setup in the signed-in page.
setup.add-connector.done: The remote client requested connection or authorization
setup.consent.title: Approve the connection
setup.consent.explain: Your Agent checks the pending connector request, approves the matching ARC access request, and completes the browser connection.
setup.verify-connector.title: Verify the remote connection
setup.verify-connector.explain: Your Agent sends the verification prompt in the selected remote conversation. This checks the connection without creating a task.
setup.verify-connector.done: Remote verification completed for this setup
setup.loop-test.title: Verify the first loop
setup.loop-test.explain: Your local Agent prepares and sends a test prompt in a Claude Code cloud session or ChatGPT conversation. ARC checks the remote task reply; the Claude loop also checks notification delivery.
setup.loop-test.done: A task from this setup completed with the required reply or delivered Claude completion notification
setup.tunnel-credentials.title: Create and configure a Secure Tunnel
setup.tunnel-credentials.explain: Your Agent creates or reuses a Tunnel in OpenAI Platform, saves its identifier, and transfers a runtime API key with Tunnels Read + Use using the official Copy button.
setup.tunnel-credentials.done: Tunnel identifier and runtime key saved for this connection
setup.enable-in-chatgpt.title: Enable the connection in ChatGPT
setup.enable-in-chatgpt.explain: Your Agent adds the Tunnel as a custom MCP server in ChatGPT, completes the risk acknowledgment and creation, then connects it in a conversation.
setup.option.fixed: Use a fixed address (provider account required)
setup.notification-skipped: Claude Code skipped: loop notifications are unavailable; only task completion and reply are verified.
setup.notification-failed: The task completed, but its Claude notification was not delivered. Check Claude Code login and the target cloud session.
setup.userRole: The Agent handles signed-in setup pages. You choose the route and help when sign-in or a policy exception requires you.
setup.promptCopied: Setup prompt copied. Paste it into your Agent conversation.
setup.continueCodex: Continue in Codex. Choices and remote steps stay in that conversation.
setup.continueAgent: Continue in the Agent conversation where you pasted the prompt.
setup.completeExplain: ARC has verified the connection and first task. Return home to see your connections.
setup.agentPrompt:
Help me configure Agent Remote Control for {goal}.
ARC CLI: {cli}. Run commands with ARC_STATE_DIR set to {stateDir} for this instance. First run `"{cli}" cli setup playbook protocol`, then loop over `"{cli}" cli setup next --locale en`.
After selecting the goal, explain the resources and local-tool access described in the protocol and obtain one scope confirmation unless already explicitly given. Then complete that scope on signed-in pages without per-item confirmation. Relay decide explanations and options; pause for missing login, challenges, passwords/2FA, payment, or your safety policy. Use setup wait as evidence. Never read or output secrets; transfer them through the official Copy button and ARC clipboard apply.
setup.otherAgentPrompt: For Claude Code, first run `"{cli}" cli skill install --target claude-code` to install the current skill.
setup.option.claude-loop.explain: Claude + Codex uses HTTPS and OAuth; automatic follow-ups in Claude Code cloud sessions need a signed-in local Claude Code CLI.
setup.option.chatgpt-chat.explain: ChatGPT Chat + Codex tries OpenAI Secure Tunnel first; if Platform access is unavailable, HTTPS + OAuth is an alternative. ChatGPT must allow custom MCP connections.
setup.codexMissing: Codex is not installed. Copy the prompt to another local Agent, or download Codex to continue.
setup.codexSignedOut: Sign in to Codex, then return here to send the setup task.
setup.choose-provider.title: Choose a fixed-address provider
setup.choose-provider.explain: Cloudflare is recommended: you need a domain hosted there. Sign in and select the domain; ARC configures the fixed address. Other providers need an existing fixed address and credential, which ARC can receive from the clipboard.
setup.cloudflare-login.title: Sign in to Cloudflare and select a domain
setup.cloudflare-login.explain: ARC opens Cloudflare authorization. Sign in and select your hosted domain. Credentials are saved on this computer automatically; no copying or pasting is needed.
setup.cloudflare-tunnel.title: Configure the Cloudflare fixed address
setup.cloudflare-tunnel.explain: ARC reuses an existing local connection or creates a dedicated one, then binds an address based on this computer’s name under your selected domain. ARC handles configuration; no secret is needed from you.
setup.cloudflare-tunnel.done: Fixed address and local connection credentials configured
setup.fixed-address: Connection address: {url}. Tell the user this address.
setup.cloudflare-managed: Cloudflare is configured through ARC sign-in; no token entry is needed.
setup.claude-code-ready.login: Claude Code is installed. ARC opens a terminal for sign-in; complete login in the terminal and browser to enable cloud session completion notifications.
setup.chatgpt-fallback.title: Choose how to continue with ChatGPT
setup.chatgpt-fallback.explain: Retry after fixing access, or use HTTPS + OAuth with a Cloudflare fixed address or temporary address. HTTPS avoids Platform Tunnel permissions, but still needs ChatGPT custom MCP access; a workspace restriction requires an administrator.
setup.blocked.chatgpt-denied: ChatGPT does not allow adding a custom MCP server in this workspace.
setup.blocked.runtime-key-rejected: OpenAI rejected the runtime key or its Tunnel permissions.
setup.runtime-key-rejected: OpenAI rejected the runtime key (401/403). Copy the correct runtime key with Tunnels Read + Use and let ARC receive it again, or choose HTTPS + OAuth instead.
setup.clipboard-invalid: The clipboard does not contain {credential}. Click the Copy button next to {credential}.
setup.health-unobserved: OpenAI control-plane authentication has not been observed yet. Keep the client running and follow the diagnostic next action if an error is reported.
controlSourceNotificationsDescription: Send task status notifications to bound control sources. Inboxes remain available when disabled.
wakeChatgpt: Work: supported with an in-chat subscription. Chat: use waits and inbox; no proactive wakeup.
wakeOther: No proactive wakeup. Use waits and inbox.
